newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down two cents to 14.85 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down two cents to 14.85 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.85 ringgit ($5.94) a kg after players kept the market in a tight range, ignoring overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), dealers said.
"This is the current level that the market wants to trade at and the LME isn't really making a difference," said a dealer. Buyers on the local market were Europeans and Malaysians.
Turnover on the local market rose to 75 tonnes from 71 tonnes on Tuesday. Bids totalled 50 tonnes against offers of 78. The local premium against London fell to $30 from $60.
